cash.name: CORRA compounded cash proxy (CAD)
cash.note: Derived from daily CORRA using ACT/365 accrual across business-day gaps. 1Y and 5Y checked against the official compounded index. The 10Y calculation spans the June 2020 methodology change; it is not an official pre-2020 index or an investable deposit return.

reference.method: Buy-and-hold terminal-wealth blend; no rebalancing, fees or taxes. Equity and bond component CAGRs are the rounded published CAD total-return index figures. CORRA is a calculated overnight cash proxy. No intervening return path is inferred.

outlook.title: Global Investment Outlook · Fall 2026
outlook.scope: RBC GAM · recommended global balanced investor mix
outlook.summary: The balanced reference recommends 61% equities, 37.5% bonds and 1.5% cash; neutral is 60 / 38 / 2. This is an outlook allocation, not the holdings of every Select portfolio.

outlook.title: Monthly Portfolio Outlook · October 2026
outlook.scope: TDAM / Wealth Asset Allocation Committee · 12–18 month views
outlook.summary: Modest overweight equities and private markets / alternatives; modest underweight fixed income. These are directional views: the reviewed page does not supply comparable five-profile target weights.

outlook.title: Macro Regime Model · Q4 2026
outlook.scope: BMO GAM ETF & Alternatives Strategy · separate model portfolio
outlook.stance: Equity overweight, with more downside buffers
outlook.summary: The model allocates 63% equities, 22% fixed income and 15% alternatives. It reduces equity downside exposure and keeps bonds underweight. This model is separate from the retail ETF Portfolio funds compared above.

outlook.title: Monthly Investment Monitor · October 2026
outlook.scope: Scotia GAM · multi-asset manager commentary / September market review
outlook.summary: Managers emphasise corporate fundamentals, diversification and flexibility through changing trade conditions. The reviewed monitor does not disclose numerical target allocations for the five profiles.

outlook.title: Perspectives · Summer 2026
outlook.scope: CIBC GAM · 12-month tactical outlook; underlying charts dated July 13
outlook.stance: Slight equity overweight versus fixed income
outlook.summary: The outlook favours equities across major regions and selective bond positioning. It provides directional tactical views, not numerical targets for each Managed Portfolio. Publication date: August 26; PDF market data: July 13.
